name: Jardim das Chegadas: Site-Off-Site, by Gabriela Vaz-Pinheiro
description: An installation by Gabriela Vaz-Pinheiro at INSTITUTO on Rua dos Clérigos, built from salvaged structures, neon tubes and prints of found aerial images of places damaged by war or ecological impact. Free.
longDescription:
Jardim das Chegadas: Site-Off-Site looks at how materials and images move between formats, scales and contexts. Gabriela Vaz-Pinheiro uses salvaged structures, neon tubes and prints made from found maps and aerial views of places damaged by war or ecological impact, spread through the building to create moments of disorientation and immersion.

The exhibition opens on Thursday, November 5, 2026, at 18:00 and runs until December 17. It is open Wednesday to Friday, 10:00 to 18:00, with free entry. Part of the work is also presented at the Galeria de Arquitectura.

INSTITUTO is at Rua dos Clérigos 44, Porto.

longDescriptionPt:
Jardim das Chegadas: Site-Off-Site explora a forma como os materiais e as imagens transitam entre formatos, escalas e contextos. A exposição inaugura na quinta-feira, 5 de novembro de 2026, às 18h00 e fica até 17 de dezembro. Está aberta de quarta a sexta, das 10h00 às 18h00, com entrada gratuita. Parte da obra é também apresentada na Galeria de Arquitectura.

O INSTITUTO fica na Rua dos Clérigos 44, no Porto.
